operational_calibration.allowed_claim: Deterministic exercise timing and queue behavior are reproducible.
forbidden_claims: The configured timings reproduce a particular clinic.
The configured event frequencies are empirically representative.

treatment_legitimacy.allowed_claim: The engine preserves source-defined abstract objectives and blocks unsupported concrete treatment content.
forbidden_claims: The engine selects a clinically valid medication, dose, route, procedure, or device setting.
The engine predicts a validated treatment effect.

human_team_behavior.allowed_claim: Role-specific projections and closed-loop communication states are represented deterministically.
forbidden_claims: The actor policies reproduce real staff behavior.
Communication delay, loss, or compliance probabilities are calibrated.

patient_dynamics.allowed_claim: Learner-visible observations are inherited from the source scenario or an exact order-linked result.
forbidden_claims: The patient physiology is continuously simulated.
Waiting or intervention effects are clinically validated.

claim_entailment.allowed_claim: Source and artifact identities can be verified.
forbidden_claims: Every citation entails the associated scenario claim.
The evidence corpus independently authorizes a treatment rule.

causal_aar.allowed_claim: The AAR reconstructs the deterministic sequence and observed outcomes.
forbidden_claims: A learner decision caused an outcome.
A counterfactual outcome is identified without a declared causal model.

executable_formal_refinement.allowed_claim: The TypeScript runtime and an independent model agree on sampled transitions, and Lean proves properties of a separate formal model.
forbidden_claims: Lean proves the complete TypeScript implementation correct.
The executable and formal semantics are fully equivalent.

accessibility.allowed_claim: Automated source checks cover known keyboard, semantic, focus, and role-separation regressions.
forbidden_claims: WCAG 2.2 AA conformance has been established.
Representative assistive-technology users have validated all critical tasks.

production_operations.allowed_claim: Local and CI release gates are designed to compare deterministic outputs and exact commits.
forbidden_claims: The deployed artifact has signed build provenance.
Canary, rollback, telemetry, and drift controls are operational.
